headline: Democrats sweep Congress, DXY 101.5 one-month low, 10y 4.93%, gold +2.3%, AMD +6% pre-market
stance: Democrats won both chambers overnight; S&P futures -1.4% at the lows, +0.2% by 4am ET. Dollar at a one-month low, 10y 4.93%, gold futures +2.3% (~4am ET).

news.head: AMD +6% pre-market: Q4 guide $17bn vs $16.2bn
news.body: Q3 revenue $13.38bn vs $13.09bn, EPS $2.09 vs $1.95; data center $8.5bn, +97%. Call: 2027 revenue growth above 80%; PC market down double digits.

news.head: Super Micro +7% after hours on a $19.9bn quarter
news.body: EPS $1.81 vs $1.23. Next-quarter revenue guide $19.5-21.5bn vs $17.4bn consensus; fiscal-year guide raised to $72-82bn.

news.head: Novo Nordisk +6% in Copenhagen, raises 2026 guide
news.body: Q3 sales DKK79.2bn vs DKK73.6bn; Wegovy pill DKK5.39bn vs DKK4.5bn. Full-year sales and profit now -2% to +2%, from -6% to 0%. New CFO named.

news.head: Block +8.6% after hours, lifts 2026 EPS guide to $4.15
news.body: Q3 EPS $1.13 vs $1.03, revenue $6.72bn vs $6.58bn. Q4 EPS guide $1.15 vs $1.16; the raise is all in the quarter just reported.

implications: A Democratic Congress means less fiscal impulse and a veto on anything new: lower yields, weaker dollar. First test: refunding, 8:30 today.
AI-hardware beats rallied after hours while hyperscalers fell pre-market. Chip demand is not the question; data-center permitting under new Democratic governors is.

watch.head: Refunding 8:30; ADP 8:15; ISM Services 10:00
watch.body: Coupon sizes expected unchanged; the guidance line on 2027 long-end cuts is the event. ADP consensus +70K after +90K; ISM Services 54.7 vs 54.9.

watch.head: Qualcomm, Arm report after today's close
watch.body: McDonald's, Uber and CVS report before the open; Datadog and MetLife after the close. Novo Nordisk's call is at 7:00 ET.

watch.head: Jobs report Nov 6, 8:30; BoE Thursday 7:00 ET
watch.body: Payrolls consensus +65K after +29K. Hike odds for the Dec 9 FOMC sit at 77% (~3am ET). Friday is the last top-tier labor print before it.

watch.head: Hormuz: Trump says no immediate strike
watch.body: Iran: the strait reopens only if sanctions are waived and the blockade ends. Four tankers hit mines south of the strait overnight, per the IRGC.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Democratic sweep: 10y 4.93%, -2bp; DXY 101.5, a one-month low; EUR/USD 1.124 (~4am ET). Trump keeps the veto, so the fiscal path narrows rather than reverses.
Dec hike odds 77% (~3am ET), from 73% Tuesday morning. JOLTS 7.52mn Tuesday vs 7.10mn consensus. Gold futures $4,032, +2.3% (~4am ET), on the weaker dollar.
Brent $104.36, +0.7% (~2:30am ET), after Tuesday's lowest settle in nearly 4 weeks. Iran calls the US reply to its 7 conditions 'not convincing'.
sections.positioning: Platinum specs extended short, 14th %ile, down 21 points on the week: the only new COT extreme. Rates and currency COT unchanged.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Nasdaq 100 futures -2.4% at the overnight low, +0.1% by 4am ET; S&P futures +0.2%, Dow +0.5%. Hyperscalers and chips lower pre-market, the rest bid.
Nikkei -1.4% Wednesday after -4.8% intraday; Kospi +0.6% after -3.5%. Hang Seng +1.7%, Shanghai +2.2%. Stoxx 600 +0.7% (~4am ET) after futures -1.5%.
Two AI-hardware beats traded up after hours while index futures sold off. Solar ETF +3% overnight: the sweep is a sector rotation, not an index call.
sections.positioning: Specs extended long Russell 2000, 99th %ile, and short VIX, 13th: unchanged 4-5 weeks. Nothing new in equity COT into the vote.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: Hyperscaler 5y CDS 100-120bp, where Mexico and South Africa trade. A 2046 AI bond priced at 8.65% Monday vs 6.55% in February: 335bp over Treasuries vs 170bp.
AI-linked HY spreads ~350bp, 100bp over non-AI HY, widest since May 2025. Roughly 33% of 2026 AI capex is bond-financed.
Big-5 tech IG spreads +31bp year-to-date vs +1bp for the IG index: the AI premium is issuer-specific, not market-wide.
sections.positioning: Primary-dealer IG inventory 21st %ile of 3 years, mid-range: no balance-sheet stress from the AI supply yet.
